context.transcript:
All right, everyone.
I'm pleased to let you know that the renovation of our outdoor dining patio is almost finished.
We anticipate that the improvements will bring more customers.
And regular customers are very excited about eating outside again.
So, that means there'll be extra shifts for anyone who would like them.
If you're interested, you can sign up in the break room.
Write your name in the time slots that you'll be available to work.
But remember, the sign up sheet will only be there for a few days.
context.transcript_translation:
好的，各位。
我很高兴地通知大家，我们的户外用餐庭院的翻修工作快完成了。
我们预计这些改进会带来更多的顾客。
而常客们对再次在户外用餐感到非常兴奋。
所以，这意味着对于任何想要额外班次的人来说都会有额外的排班。
如果您感兴趣，您可以在休息室报名。
请在您能工作的时段写下您的名字。
但请记住，报名表只会在那里几天时间。
